caseNameFull: John McComish, Applicants v. Ken Bennett, Secretary of State of the State of Arizona

opinions.text: Application to vacate the stay presented to Justice Kennedy, and by *1244him referred to the Court, denied without prejudice to a renewed application if the parties represent that they intend to file a timely petition for a writ of certiorari before this Court. Motion of Buzz Mills for Governor Campaign for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted.
